search_notes: Checked on 2026-10-02 using a 90-day cutoff of 2026-07-04. Every listed repository was verified through gh api repos/OWNER/REPO and repos/OWNER/REPO/releases/latest, plus its README; all are public, non-archived, and have a qualifying release or default-branch commit. GritQL's seed URL redirects to biomejs/gritql. Comby was excluded: its latest release is dated 2022-06-28 and its default-branch commit is dated 2026-06-08. gopatch also failed the freshness cutoff. stx lacked a verified open-source license and CLI documentation. Coccinelle remains an unverified lead because a malformed response filter prevented its README verification. Six attempted web searches timed out; discovery continued through GitHub repository search. Used 30 GitHub API calls and eight README page fetches, without opening workspace files. Entries are alphabetical. Exhaustive coverage could not be established within the budget.
